description: This file implements the GLX-specific parts of the egl::Display interface for the ANGLE project, including context creation, surface management, extension handling, and device loss testing for the Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit platform.

classes.name: FunctionsGLGLX
classes.description: Implementation of FunctionsGL for GLX, responsible for loading OpenGL functions via getProc.

classes.name: WorkerContextGLX
classes.description: Represents a worker GLX context used for parallel shader compilation or background tasks.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DisplayGLX, sets up GLX, creates contexts, and configures extensions.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroys contexts, surfaces, and closes display connections.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a specified surface and context current in the thread.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface for rendering.

methods.name: createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer surface.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Unimplemented; intended to create a pbuffer from a client buffer.

methods.name: createPixmapSurface
methods.description: Unimplemented; intended to create a pixmap surface.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a GLX context, either with attributes or default.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Unimplemented; intended to create a device object.

methods.name: testDeviceLost
methods.description: Checks if the device has been lost, based on context reset status.

methods.name: restoreLostDevice
methods.description: Returns an error indicating device restoration is not supported.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a native window handle is valid.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns an empty string; unimplemented.

methods.name: waitClient
methods.description: Waits for GL commands to complete.

methods.name: waitNative
methods.description: Waits for native driver events, such as window resize, to complete.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported OpenGL ES version.

methods.name: syncXCommands
methods.description: Synchronizes X commands if using a new X display.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for a drawable, using available extensions.

methods.name: isValidWindowVisualId
methods.description: Checks if a visual ID matches the requested visual.

methods.name: generateExtensions
methods.description: Generates supported EGL extensions based on GLX capabilities.

methods.name: generateCaps
methods.description: Generates EGL capabilities, e.g., NPOT textures support.

methods.name: makeCurrentSurfaceless
methods.description: Makes the context current without a surface.

methods.name: getGLXFBConfigAttrib
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute from a GLXFBConfig.

methods.name: createContextAttribs
methods.description: Creates a GLX context with specified attributes.

methods.name: initializeFrontendFeatures
methods.description: Initializes frontend features based on the renderer.

methods.name: populateFeatureList
methods.description: Populates feature list from renderer features.
